entities.name: Sitting Bull
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hunkpapa Lakota leader (c. 1831-1890) who united Sioux tribes against U.S. government encroachment. His spiritual leadership at the Battle of the Little Bighorn (1876) — where combined Native forces defeated Custer's 7th Cavalry — made him an enduring symbol of indigenous resistance to colonial expansion in North America.
